detail.headline: Results: Support for foreign translations of Czech literature
detail.excerpt: Grants, scholarships..., News 1. 9. 2026 The Ministry of Culture of the Czech Republic has released the results of the Support Programme for Publishing Translations of Czech Literature Abroad for 2026 – second round. All information, including the link to download the document with the supported projects, can be found on the Ministry’s website here. CzechLit
